definition: GPT-4.5 (codenamed "Orion") is a large language model developed by OpenAI as part of the GPT series.
details: Officially released on February 27, 2025, GPT-4.5 is available to users subscribed to the ChatGPT Plus and Pro plans across web, mobile, and desktop platforms. Access was also provided through the OpenAI API and Developer Playground until July 14, 2025. On August 7, 2025, with the release of GPT-5, GPT-4.5 was removed from both the API and ChatGPT users with the Plus and Teams tier, while Pro users are still able to access to GPT-4.5 model under the "Legacy Models" tab. On May 28th, 2026, It was announced that GPT-4.5 would be sunset completely from ChatGPT on June 27th, 2026.

explainer.lead: GPT-4.5, codenamed Orion, is an OpenAI large language model in the GPT series. Released on February 27, 2025, it was offered through ChatGPT and OpenAI’s developer tools before being progressively retired.

tiers.eli5: GPT-4.5 is like a very advanced writing and conversation partner made by OpenAI. People could type to it through ChatGPT on the web, a phone, or a computer, and developers could also connect their own programs to it. Over time, OpenAI replaced it with GPT-5 and announced that GPT-4.5 would leave ChatGPT completely on June 27, 2026.
tiers.practitioner: Developers could access GPT-4.5 through the OpenAI API and Developer Playground until July 14, 2025. In ChatGPT, availability later narrowed to Pro users under Legacy Models, so integrations and workflows depending on it must account for its retirement rather than treating it as a stable long-term endpoint.
tiers.paperLevel: GPT-4.5 (Orion) is formally identified as an OpenAI large language model in the GPT series, released on February 27, 2025. GPT-5 followed on August 7, 2025, after which GPT-4.5 remained available to ChatGPT Pro users as a legacy model; complete removal from ChatGPT was announced for June 27, 2026.

explainer.example: A Pro subscriber could open ChatGPT, select GPT-4.5 under Legacy Models, and continue a conversation after Plus and Teams users had lost access. That option was scheduled to disappear with the complete ChatGPT sunset on June 27, 2026.

explainer.origin: OpenAI developed GPT-4.5 as part of the GPT series and officially released it on February 27, 2025.
explainer.lineage: GPT-5 was released on August 7, 2025, and GPT-4.5 was removed for Plus and Teams users while remaining available to Pro users as a legacy model. On May 28, 2026, OpenAI announced that GPT-4.5 would be sunset completely from ChatGPT on June 27, 2026.
explainer.whyItMatters: Its changing availability shows why model choice is also an operational decision: an application built around a specific model may need to migrate when API access or consumer support ends.
